name: Progression — Withdrawal Introduced in the Same PUT as the New Course
description: Variant of progression-multi-put-withdrawal: the initial POST leaves ZSC00001 active (no withdrawalDate) and it is approved in that state. SLD then PUTs a single payload that simultaneously adds the withdrawalDate to ZSC00001 and introduces ZSC00002 as a new course — rather than ZSC00001 already being withdrawn before the progression PUT arrives. Exploratory: checking how the handler copes with the withdrawal and the progression both landing in the same request.

steps.name: SLD Creates Short Course 1 (ZSC00001, active, no withdrawal)
SLD PUTs ZSC00001 (now withdrawn) and ZSC00002 (new course) in a Single Payload
